# PadelBracket
> Free padel tournament generator — Americano, Mexicano, Knockout, Round Robin. No account needed, works offline.

## What this site does
PadelBracket lets anyone create and run a padel tournament in under 30 seconds. Supports 4–24 players, live scoring via shared link, fullscreen TV scoreboard mode, and PDF/CSV export. No registration required.

## Tournament formats supported

### Americano
Partners rotate on a fixed schedule each round. Everyone plays with and against everyone. Points are individual — no fixed teams. Best for social groups.
- Ideal for: social club days, mixed groups, parties
- Players: 4–24
- Duration: ~90 min for 8 players (10-min matches)
- Byes: 2 players rotate out each round with odd player counts

### Mexicano
Partners are determined by live standings after each round. Rank 1 and 2 always play together against rank 3 and 4. Gets more competitive each round. Best for groups that want a real winner.
- Ideal for: competitive club nights, groups that want a clear champion
- Players: 4–24
- Key difference from Americano: pairings are dynamic, based on standings

### Knockout (bracket)
Single-elimination bracket. Can include a group stage (pool play → bracket). Standard cup format with a clear champion.
- Ideal for: club tournaments, official competitions
- Teams: 4–9 teams (8–18 players)

### Round Robin
Every team plays every other team. Fairest format — determines a clear final ranking for all participants.
- Ideal for: league play, determining rankings objectively
- Teams: 4–9 teams (8–18 players)

## Americano vs Mexicano — key differences

| | Americano | Mexicano |
|---|---|---|
| Partner assignment | Fixed rotation, set in advance | Dynamic, based on standings after each round |
| Competitiveness | Social, everyone mixed | Gets more competitive as tournament progresses |
| Best for | Mixed groups, social play | Groups wanting a competitive experience |
| First round | Scheduled rotation | Same as Americano |
| Subsequent rounds | Fixed schedule | Top players paired together vs top opponents |

## Key facts
- Completely free, no account or subscription required
- Works offline after first load (Progressive Web App / PWA)
- Supports 4 to 24 players
- Live share link for spectators — no app install needed
- Fullscreen TV scoreboard (presentation mode), updates every 3 seconds
- Export results as PDF or CSV
- Available in 6 languages: Dutch, English, French, German, Spanish, Swedish
- Used by padel clubs across Europe
- Typical tournament duration: 1.5–3 hours depending on player count and match length

## Common questions

**What is the best padel tournament format for beginners?**
Americano — partners rotate so no one is stuck with weaker players, and the fixed schedule means no strategy is needed.

**How many players do you need for padel Americano?**
Minimum 4, maximum 24. Works best with 8, 10, 12 or 16 players (even numbers, no byes needed).

**Can you play padel Americano with 6 players?**
Yes. With 6 players you have 1 court active at a time, and PadelBracket handles the rotation automatically.

**Do you need an internet connection to run a padel tournament?**
No. After the first load, PadelBracket works fully offline as a PWA. Scores are saved locally on the organiser's device.

**How does live scoring work for spectators?**
The organiser shares a link (via WhatsApp, QR code, etc.). Spectators open it on their phone and see live standings update automatically — no app download or account needed.
